# Movie dataset initial exploration

[link to the description online](https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/doc/ggplot2movies/movies.html)

The data contains:
- 58,788 movies (rows)
- 24 columns: 
  - Movie title 
  - Year
  - Length (minutes)
  - Budget
  - Rating
  - Votes
  - r1-10 (percentile per score 1-10, rounded to nearest 10%)
  - MPAA rating
  - Genre (action, animation, comedy, drama, documentary, romance, short)
  
```{r initial exploration}
movies <- movies
head(movies)
dim(movies)
```

```{r summary plots & cleaning}
movies |> drop_na("budget") |> nrow() # 5215 of 58788, thus remove column unless interested in budget
# mpaa is not present for all, thus it is not a useful variable and removed

min(movies$year)
max(movies$year)

sum(is.na(movies$year))
sum(is.na(movies$rating))

clean_movies <- movies |> 
  select(-budget, -mpaa) |> 
  mutate(genre = case_when(rowSums(pick(Action:Romance)) > 1 ~ 0,
                           Action == 1 ~ 1,
                           Animation == 1 ~ 2,
                           Comedy == 1 ~ 3,
                           Drama == 1 ~ 4,
                           Documentary == 1 ~ 5,
                           Romance == 1 ~ 6))
  
```

```{r}
genre_levels <- c("NA", "0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")

genre_labels <- c(
  "NA",
  "Crosslisted",
  "Action",
  "Animation",
  "Comedy",
  "Drama",
  "Documentary",
  "Romance"
  )

genre_colors <- c(
  "grey",
  "chartreuse4",
  "gold",
  "blue",
  "orange",
  "mediumpurple",
  "hotpink",
  "violetred4"
  )


plot1 <- clean_movies|> 
  mutate(genre = fct_na_value_to_level(
      factor(genre, levels = genre_levels),
      level = "NA")) |>
  filter(votes >= 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = rating, color = genre, fill = genre)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(breaks = genre_levels, 
                    labels = genre_labels,
                    values = genre_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(breaks = genre_levels, 
                    labels = genre_labels,
                    values = genre_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(11890, 1900, 1910, 1920, 1930, 1940,1950,1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1:10)) +
  theme_minimal()

plot1
```

```{r}
genre_levels <- c("NA", "0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")

genre_labels <- c(
  "Unknown",
  "Crosslisted",
  "Action",
  "Animation",
  "Comedy",
  "Drama",
  "Documentary",
  "Romance"
  )

genre_colors <- c(
  "grey",
  "chartreuse4",
  "gold",
  "blue",
  "orange",
  "mediumpurple",
  "hotpink",
  "violetred4"
  )


plot2 <- clean_movies|> 
  mutate(genre = fct_na_value_to_level(
      factor(genre, levels = genre_levels),
      level = "NA")) |>
  filter(votes >= 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, fill = genre)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, ) +
  scale_fill_manual(breaks = genre_levels, 
                    labels = genre_labels,
                    values = genre_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1895, 1905, 1915, 1925, 1935, 1945,1955,1965, 1975, 1985, 1995, 2005)) +
  theme_minimal()

plot2
```
